commits.summary: Freeze five Java public changes and their twenty proof obligations
commits.body:
Pin the landed sources, first parents, original test methods, public adapters, startup, bounds and expected results for examples 363–367 before measuring the verifier. The independent grids contain 64 nested buffer inputs, four enum pairs, 128 JSON feed schedules, fourteen CSV fixtures and four evolved records. The opening inventory covers 233 verifier and workflow files.

Verified every first parent and original production and test path, all 25 task plans and eleven deliberately wrong observations. The changed suite passed 59 Rust binaries and 32 Python groups. The example form checks still await the paired Maven artifacts and fresh replay receipts. The build jobs follow this freeze.
